title: Kartu Pos dari Tampere
mood: shy, sweet and a little comic
subject: a young Pos Indonesia courier in Malang who delivers Postcrossing postcards from Finland, Taiwan, Belarus and Germany to the same woman every Tuesday, reads them at the red light, and finally buys a card at his own post office counter to invite her for coffee, which he then has to deliver himself
caption: Indonesian retro indie pop in the vein of The Lantis and Naif, nostalgic and gentle, with a slow-swaying 1960s-70s band sound. A clean semi-hollow electric guitar with a light amp-tremolo shimmer playing a sweet single-note hook; a semi-hollow guitar strumming steady chords; a melodic picked bass; a combo organ holding soft sustained chords; dry drums with rim clicks in the verses and tambourine on the chorus. Warm tape-saturated band-in-a-room recording, vintage rolled-off top end, light room reverb. Young male lead vocal, soft and slightly nasal, close and intimate, with a second male voice in two-part harmony on the chorus. 96 BPM, D major. Shy, sweet and a little comic. No synths, no programmed drums, no autotune, no city-pop slap bass, no surf-rock tremolo picking, no power ballad build.
lyrics:
[Intro - clean guitar hook and organ]

[Verse 1]
Jalan Ijen, rumah tua, belnya sudah lama rusak
Tiap Selasa aku berhenti, teriak pos, pos, dari pagar
Kartu pos dari Tampere, gambarnya danau beku
Perangko rusa kutub, cap posnya agak luntur

[Pre-Chorus]
Bukan buat aku, aku cuma tukang antar
Tapi aku hafal jam berapa kamu buka pintu

[Chorus - two-part harmony]
Kartu pos dari jauh, satu lagi buat kamu
Dari orang yang nggak kamu kenal, tapi tahu alamatmu
Aku cuma kurir yang selalu telat lima menit
Yang diam-diam baca dulu di lampu merah

[Verse 2]
Dari Kaohsiung ada kereta, dari Minsk ada gereja
Dari Leipzig ada nenek cerita soal tomat di kebunnya
Kamu tanya, Mas, kok tahu yang ini dari Jerman?
Aku pura-pura lihat perangko, padahal sudah kubaca

[Chorus - two-part harmony]
Kartu pos dari jauh, satu lagi buat kamu
Dari orang yang nggak kamu kenal, tapi tahu alamatmu
Kamu ketawa di pintu, aku lupa pasang standar
Motorku hampir nyungsep ke selokan depan rumahmu

[Bridge - organ and tremolo guitar, drums drop to rim clicks]
Sabtu kubeli satu kartu di loket kantorku sendiri
Gambarnya Tugu Malang, perangkonya kutempel miring

[Chorus - two-part harmony]
Kartu pos dari dekat, satu lagi buat kamu
Dari orang yang kamu kenal, yang selalu telat lima menit
Isinya cuma, Minggu depan mau ngopi di Kayutangan?
Selasa pagi kartunya sampai, aku juga yang ngantar

[Outro - clean guitar hook fades with the organ]
